name: Wei Tong
source:
A prominent figure at Huayi High School. Known as "Wei Tong the Stomach Aches" due to his frequent stomach aches. He's obsessed with basketball and video games, and is highly skilled in League of Legends. He's the protagonist's male best friend and will look after him on various occasions.
